g.text: Title: USB-C device connector / ESD / CC current detection

g.desc: Title: USB-C device connector / ESD / CC current detection

g.text: Sheet: /USB-C device connector / ESD / CC current detection/

g.desc: Sheet: /USB-C device connector / ESD / CC current detection/

g.text: only C324 at attach. EN low: always enabled. VBUS_POWER (USB_VPWR, <= 5.5 V) feeds the USB-sense divider.

g.desc: only C324 at attach. EN low: always enabled. VBUS_POWER (USB_VPWR, <= 5.5 V) feeds the USB-sense divider.

g.text: TPD1S514-1: OVP 5.90-5.99 V, off in 100 ns, 30 V DC and 100 V surge on VBUS_CON, 39 mOhm. 20 ms delay + 3.5 ms soft start at plug-in, so the source sees

g.desc: TPD1S514-1: OVP 5.90-5.99 V, off in 100 ns, 30 V DC and 100 V surge on VBUS_CON, 39 mOhm. 20 ms delay + 3.5 ms soft start at plug-in, so the source sees

g.text: carries reverse current to USB_5V after unplug (TI: <= 15 mA through the LDO).

g.desc: carries reverse current to USB_5V after unplug (TI: <= 15 mA through the LDO).

g.text: TUSB320LAI presents sink terminations and reports advertised current over I2C. No PD. VBUS_DET through 887k from the connector side (TI: system VBUS up to 28 V).

g.desc: TUSB320LAI presents sink terminations and reports advertised current over I2C. No PD. VBUS_DET through 887k from the connector side (TI: system VBUS up to 28 V).

g.text: USB-C 5 V SINK - NO PD, DATA TO MODULE, VBUS OVERVOLTAGE CUT-OFF, VBUS TO THE BQ25798 CHARGER

g.desc: USB-C 5 V SINK - NO PD, DATA TO MODULE, VBUS OVERVOLTAGE CUT-OFF, VBUS TO THE BQ25798 CHARGER

g.text: Step 14: U323 TPD1S514-1 disconnects USB_5V from the connector above 5.99 V within 100 ns; VBUS_CON is rated 30 V DC. No duplicate Rd: the CC controller contains the sink terminations.

g.desc: Step 14: U323 TPD1S514-1 disconnects USB_5V from the connector above 5.99 V within 100 ns; VBUS_CON is rated 30 V DC. No duplicate Rd: the CC controller contains the sink terminations.

g.text: Route the USB 2.0 pair short and matched, directly to the module. Place U323 and C324 next to J310; keep VBUS_CON copper short and on the top layer (TI layout guide).

g.desc: Route the USB 2.0 pair short and matched, directly to the module. Place U323 and C324 next to J310; keep VBUS_CON copper short and on the top layer (TI layout guide).

g.text: Divider from USB_VPWR and Schmitt inverters give USB_ABSENT (gates SERVICE_OK) and USB_PRESENT (to MCU), also while U323 blocks an overvoltage source.

g.desc: Divider from USB_VPWR and Schmitt inverters give USB_ABSENT (gates SERVICE_OK) and USB_PRESENT (to MCU), also while U323 blocks an overvoltage source.

g.text: TPS7A2050: 5.0 V +/-1.5 % to module pad 31, because the nRF52840 VBUS pin is rated 5.5 V (5.8 V absolute) and the OVP ceiling is 5.99 V. D324 BAT54

g.desc: TPS7A2050: 5.0 V +/-1.5 % to module pad 31, because the nRF52840 VBUS pin is rated 5.5 V (5.8 V absolute) and the OVP ceiling is 5.99 V. D324 BAT54

g.text: USB 2.0 data to the module; duplicate contacts joined. TPD2E2U06 on D+/D-, CC and USB_5V is ESD only. J310 VBUS contacts are VBUS_CON, before the overvoltage switch.

g.desc: USB 2.0 data to the module; duplicate contacts joined. TPD2E2U06 on D+/D-, CC and USB_5V is ESD only. J310 VBUS contacts are VBUS_CON, before the overvoltage switch.
